correctness.rationale: The complete exact certificate constructs the icosahedral edge graph and all 32 facets of its rectification. Reflection identities are verified algebraically for every one of the 30 hyperplanes and 12 original vertices. Elementary connectivity of hyperplane chamber adjacencies then makes reference incidence (3,7) uniform over infinitely many directions; strict-inequality perturbation bounds nongeneric directions. The twelve five-valent vertices give the matching lower bound four for both ordinary and fractional objectives. Four explicitly exhibited integer directions cover all 32 vertices with exact sign inequalities. No finite sampling is substituted for a global proof.

value.rationale: This determines two natural convex-geometric invariants exactly for a canonical 32-vertex Catalan solid and proves the structurally stronger all-direction two-orbit (3,7) rigidity. The two-orbit mechanism matters because the usual vertex-transitive shortcut does not apply, and the four-witness cover exactly saturates the five-valent fractional counting bound. The invariants are naturally used in Hadwiger-type covering and illumination comparisons, including with the polar icosidodecahedron.
